Title: Users may be unable to load themes in Outlook on the web

User impact: Users may be unable to load themes in Outlook on the web.

Current status: We've identified an issue occurring during the Outlook on the web startup process that's preventing themes from loading as expected. We're reviewing system logs to understand what is causing the behavior, which will help us isolate our next steps toward remediation.

Scope of impact: Impact is specific to users attempting to load themes in Outlook on the web. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.
